sentences.en: I anticipate that there will be problems on their expedition.
sentences.zh: 我预计他们在探险过程中会遇到问题。

sentences.en: Anticipating a cold winter, we bought a bigger stove.
sentences.zh: 考虑到冬天可能会很冷，我们买了一个更大的炉子。

sentences.en: Nobody anticipated such a sharp decline in interest rates.
sentences.zh: 没人预料到利率会有如此大的降幅。

senses.zh: 预料，预期，期望，抢...前，语言，提前使用
